mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate consistently compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and increased liquidity.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as predictor of 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window or correlation with returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances where UNRATE >5.0% for two consecutive months or average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: Interaction term between HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window or negative return pattern not observed in >60% of interaction-triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing slowdowns reduce corporate output and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recessionary risks are priced in.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in >60% of instances where INDPRO < 100 or average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payroll employment signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS as predictor of 5-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window or correlation with returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher interest rates pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances where year-over-year CPIAUCSL >2.5% or average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real GDP and housing starts indicates strong economic expansion and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: Interaction term between GDPC1 and HOUST fails to predict SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window or positive return pattern not observed in >60% of interaction-triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy shift to combat inflation reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS >5.0% or average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
